title: Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit Extensions Sized in Blocks by Rate Lock Term
content:
For a Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit backed by a rate lock of 90 days or more, and only for such a credit, the extension is sized to the closing as follows, and it still raises the extension count by one. The days granted follow the Rate Lock Commitment on the loan file:

- under a Larkspur 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock, the days the Heroes extension must cover are rounded up to a whole number of 15-day blocks;
- under a Larkspur 90-Day Rate Lock or Larkspur 120-Day Extended Rate Lock, they are rounded up to a whole number of 10-day blocks;
- a count that is already a whole number of blocks stands as it is;
- under any other lock, the extension adds the program's extension days.

The days the Heroes extension must cover are never below zero.

| Rate lock product on the file | Days granted |
|---|---|
| Larkspur 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock | the days to cover, rounded up to a whole number of 15-day blocks |
| Larkspur 90-Day Rate Lock or Larkspur 120-Day Extended Rate Lock | the days to cover, rounded up to a whole number of 10-day blocks |
| any other lock (Larkspur 15-Day, 30-Day, 45-Day or 60-Day Rate Lock) | the program's extension days |

### Worked figures (hypothetical days to cover)

| Days the extension must cover | 15-day blocks | 10-day blocks |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 0 |
| 23 | 30 | 30 |
| 30 | 30 | 30 |
| 31 | 45 | 40 |
| 44 | 45 | 50 |
